headline: Callahan Passage and Mooring Reawaken Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Wires since 0610 show fresh movement on two fronts previously still, while the heaviest exchanges press on elsewhere. Callahan's Passage reports four transfers in two hours about Crumbling Post, latest at the hour, with day losses at 5,467 Colonial and 4,527 Warden quickening. Mooring County counts eight transfers in two hours about the Wind Hills, last heard at 0845, with 3,517 Colonial and 2,438 Warden losses on the day. Linn Mercy remains busy with five in two hours, eighteen in six and forty on the day about Rotdust, Lathair and Outwich Ranch, latest at 0815, losses at 8,800 Colonial and 11,281 Warden. The Weathered Expanse adds two in two hours, seven in six and forty-three on the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk for four Warden, two Colonial and three ruined posts. The Nevish Line has gone quiet in two hours, last heard at 0410, though ten in six and forty-five on the day about Mistle Shrine and Princefal, while Stonecradle records none in two and six hours, last heard yesterday about World's End.
